The perspective is dramatic, looking up at the device.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The red light exhibits a strange, swirling, fibrous texture rather than a uniform glow or distinct LED points. This looks like an AI artifact where the light source is 'melting' or has incorrect internal geometry.

The yellow light contains a distinct, nonsensical geometric shape (resembling a distorted rectangle or bracket) inside the circular lens. Real traffic lights do not have solid opaque shapes floating inside the illuminated area; this indicates a failure in rendering the light source correctly.
Slight warping in the straight lines of the housing visors, particularly on the right side, suggesting minor geometric instability common in AI generations.
